scenes.text: Still sorting every email yourself? Your inbox could be running an AI workflow instead.
Here is the trick: an incoming message triggers an automation, not another task for you.
With n8n or Zapier, you can connect your inbox to AI and other apps.
AI can classify the message, draft a reply, and create a task for follow-up.
But do not auto-send everything. Test the workflow and keep human approval for sensitive replies.
Would you automate your inbox first, or your calendar? Comment your pick.
